subject: C31
required_fixes: R1 — crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:3513 and :4162; crates/desktop-core/src/authority/change_domain.rs:903; apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/native_confirmation.rs:153, :176 and :219: renderer retirement does not revoke native presentation already admitted or queued. RevealSecret removes the secret from its record into an effect, releases the state lock, and later schedules presentation without a page/review lifetime binding. Teardown can dismiss the current sheet before that effect or its AppKit callback executes; the later callback then creates a new secret sheet and permits copying after the review/page has ended. NativeSecrets allocates its ownership generation inside the presentation callback, and dismiss does not invalidate queued callbacks. The pinned Tauri runtime executes main-thread tasks inline while queuing tasks from other threads, so dismissal cannot establish the required ordering. Confirmation presentation has the same stale-sheet problem: present does not verify that its nonce remains pending. Core settlement still prevents the retired confirmation from applying a mutation; the defect does not establish a mutation-authority bypass. Acceptance: bind admitted presentation to revocable native page/review ownership and check it when presentation actually executes, covering both the admission-to-effect and queued-callback windows. Deterministic production-path regressions must retire the page in both windows, then drain callbacks and establish no secret presentation/copy, no stale confirmation sheet, no mutation replay, preserved admitted outcomes, and successful explicit fresh-page work.

R2 — tools/native-acceptance/administration_coverage.py:70 and :97; tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c31.py:149; tools/native-acceptance/mgmt_server.py:539: Gateway detail negatives still pass without reaching a successful detail/action surface. The checker requires a detail container and Close details but accepts loading or failed details. Every retained service-key and user-key detail tree in both current C31 and C39 says 'The service did not find this resource.' and contains only Close details. The fixture lists seeded keys but supplies detail replies only for newly created service keys. Thus the strengthened mapping still cannot establish the mandatory native restrictions where successful key details render their admitted actions. Acceptance: provide contract-correct successful detail fixtures for the listed keys in both kinds, wait for each successful detail to settle, require its expected admitted actions including Rotate, and reject loading/error/absent/incomplete panels as restriction evidence. Add negative probes for these states and forbidden controls, then retain fresh affected native observations and captures. Preserve all existing raw results.
